title: S092 16.2 Invalidation after Updates or Deletions
parent_path: S092 16.2 Invalidation after Updates or Deletions

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: Some RTSP methods MUST cause a cache to invalidate an entity.
actions: invalidate entity referred to by Request-URI
invalidate entity referred to by Location header if present
invalidate entity referred to by Content-Location header if present

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: In order to prevent DoS attacks, an invalidation based on the URI in a Location or Content-Location header MUST only be performed if the host part is the same as in the Request-URI.
actions: perform Location/Content-Location-based invalidation only when host part matches Request-URI host part

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: A cache that passes through requests for methods it does not understand SHOULD invalidate any entities referred to by the Request-URI.
actions: invalidate all entities referred to by Request-URI
